summary: Customer is unable to access loan balance online.

intents.keywords: I tried checking my ... account not found help.

issues.issue: Customer cannot access loan balance online.
issues.reason(s): Account not linked to the online portal.

intents.actions of agent: Agent confirmed the account number and linked the account to the portal. Agent also offered to send login instructions and a guide, and provided further assistance if needed.
intents.resolution: Account linked to the portal and login instructions sent.

intents.keywords: Ok but I am ... will it be easy?

issues.issue: Customer is not comfortable with online processes.
issues.reason(s): Lack of familiarity with online systems.

intents.actions of agent: Agent assured the customer that the process is simple and offered a guide and further assistance.
intents.resolution: Agent provided reassurance and offered a guide and further support.
